terminal_states.passed: The stage's declared evidence and invariants hold for its exact inputs.
terminal_states.failed: An evaluated stage invariant is false or a required negative control survives.
terminal_states.blocked: A required predecessor, runtime, owner input, or safety boundary is absent or unavailable.
terminal_states.indeterminate: Execution completed without enough typed evidence to establish passed or failed.
terminal_states.not_applicable: The selected profile explicitly authorizes non-application with a bound rule and reason code.

stages.name: exact-semantic-source
stages.owns: exact owner-authored meaning and source identity

stages.name: exact-implementation-binding
stages.owns: unique current implementation and fixture binding

stages.name: check-or-proof-target-selection
stages.owns: bound executable check, provider request, or theorem target

stages.name: runtime-and-provider-admission
stages.owns: exact bounded provider runtime and isolation evidence

stages.name: native-result-normalization
stages.owns: non-inflating mapping with native truth retained

stages.name: independent-verification
stages.owns: read-only recomputation by a separate executable

stages.name: replay-and-currentness
stages.owns: per-reference currentness and deterministic repeated execution

invariants: issued claim <= exact evidence <= admitted meaning
all thirteen stages are represented exactly once
evidence composition cannot widen a claim ceiling
product approval and operational authority are separate owner decisions
claim_limit: Prototype definitions only; no admission, conformance, product approval, adoption, enforcement, release, deployment, or production authority.
